heat_pump.notes: Estimated: the 2024 SE Standard Range was repackaged with a lower price and KBB 2024 says standard features, including heated front seats, were dropped; Cars.com 2025 says the Standard Range lacks the heat pump that long-range SE has. The 2023 version (with a heat pump) is the only year that had it. 2024 and 2025 compared; no 2024 equipment sheet opened. KBB 2025 says "minor changes", so the 2025 value carries back; the 2023 sheet lists a heat pump on this trim, so the year it was dropped (2024) is inferred.
